historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Bushr (The Star-guided): a surah of the Quran The name Bushr carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Bushr is mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah, Verse 260 of the Quran. It is one of the names of the 'Night Journey' (Isra and Mi'raj) of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). According to Islamic tradition, during this journey, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was taken to Jerusalem and then to the 'Farthest Mosque' in Jerusalem, from where he ascended to the heavens and visited different levels of paradise and the presence of Allah (swt). The name Bushr refers to the star which guided Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the mystical journey. The exact location of the star Bushr or Al-Baitul-Ma'mur is unknown.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bushr bin Abi Bikr Al-Asadi: A famous companion of Imam Ali (a.s.) The name Bushr carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Bushr bin Abi Bikr Al-Asadi was a prominent Shia leader and companion of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.), the fourth caliph according to Shia Muslims. He was known for his knowledge, piety, and bravery. During the Battle of Siffin in 657 AD, Bushr played a crucial role in supporting Imam Ali (a.s.) against Muawiya's forces. He was later martyred in the Battle of Nahrawan in 658 AD while defending Imam Ali (a.s.) against the rebel forces of Ibn Al-Ash'ath.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bushr has modern context in various fields, including Islamic history where it is associated with a noble companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). In the gaming industry, Bushr is a popular username for gamers on PC platforms such as Steam and Battle.net. In the technology field, Bushr is the name of a mobile application that offers Islamic services, including Qibla direction and prayer times. The general trend is the increasing usage of Islamic names and identities in digital spaces, reflecting the growing importance of technology and gaming in Muslim communities.
